Pterothamnion crispum — Regional account; local occurrence is not native origin.

Description: Thallus small , monosiphonous, erect in tufts to 1.5 cm long, branching pseudodichotomously in whorls of 4 on the axis.

Habitat: Epiphytic and epizoic from low littoral to 10m sublittoral.

Distribution: British Isles on southwestern coasts: Ireland, Wales, England, Isle of Man and the Channel Islands. Europe: Mediterranean and Spain to the Netherlands. Further afield: Canary Islands.

Distribution Map from NBN: Pterothamnion crispum at National Biodiversity Network mapping facility, data for UK.
